CREATE TABLE images (
	digest TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
	body BLOB NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE store_metadata (
	singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),
	format TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX active_image_collector ON cleanup_intents (
	resource_kind,
	resource_id
) WHERE resource_kind IN ('import_work','image_cache') AND status='pending';

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX single ON t (resource_id) WHERE resource_kind='supply_cleanup';

CREATE TABLE notes (
	id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
	body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(body<>'a;b'),
	UNIQUE(id)
);
